description: Android application deployment targets. Device OS/ABI compatibility is independent of builder host OS/architecture.

notes: This profile is for Android application deployment, not Android OS or device firmware flashing.
The E Ink panel and waveform/EPDC integration are BSP-specific; the generic Android SDK does not provide the vendor display driver or HAL.
Native libraries must include armeabi-v7a; Java/Kotlin-only APKs do not need a native ABI payload.
